audience: Sales teams that run prospect lists and email cadences in Klenty

useCases.title: Browse prospect lists
useCases.text: List the prospect lists your team created, then list the prospects in one list, with paging.

useCases.title: Find prospects by date
useCases.text: List the prospects created in a date range, or the prospects updated in a date range by their last interaction.

useCases.title: Check a prospect's cadence status
useCases.text: Read the cadence status and the prospect status of one prospect by email. List all cadences of the team.

useCases.title: Add or update a prospect
useCases.text: Create a prospect in a list, or change the fields you pass on a prospect found by its current email.

useCases.title: Start or stop a cadence
useCases.text: Add a prospect to a cadence, or remove it from one cadence or from all cadences. Cadences send real emails on schedule.

useCases.title: Review webhook subscriptions
useCases.text: List the webhook subscriptions of the account, with their URLs and ids.
